{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate = df_dedup[(df_dedup["arm"] == "control") & (df_dedup["severity"] == "moderate")]

# Check: how many such patients?
print('Control arm, moderate severity count:', len(control_moderate))

# How many responded?
responded_count = control_moderate["responded"].sum()
print('Responded count:', responded_count)

# Compute fraction
fraction = responded_count / len(control_moderate)
print('Fraction responded:', fraction)"}
